quests.title: The Airbridge Manifest
quests.summary: The Airbridge runs on paperwork. Collect the distances from the Control Tower and a signature from the Loadmaster, and bring the manifest back.

steps.text: Take the manifest from the Duty Officer at Airbridge Operations.
Ask the Duty Controller in the Control Tower how far the Airbridge flies.
Get the Loadmaster on the apron to sign it (he only signs for people who can beat him), then report back.

quests.reward: Three flasks of tea, three cups of tea and standing with the Overseas Territories.
